facts.statement: hc_scraper.py reads hiring.cafe's /api/search-jobs JSON from the page context after one browser navigation; each saved filter is one search config built from base + location preset + overrides.
A hiring.cafe hit becomes a scrape row only when its source is Greenhouse or Lever and it has fewer than 100 viewers; blocked companies come from filters/active.json.
processed_jobs.csv is append-only and keyed by posting identity, so the same posting is never notified twice; it lives under JOBKIT_DATA.

One synchronous notifier covers print, webhook and Discord. NOTIFY=print needs no secret; DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN plus DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID are required for Discord, and a DM additionally needs ENABLE_DM=1 and DM_USER_ID.
bin/ats-poll reads the board registry and asks public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday endpoints; a board enters the registry only after its API answered 200.
This package pins NLC 0.8.0 and gates on rule coverage, the rule IR snapshot and the call tree; the private repo's C1-C26 release audit is not shipped.
